_note: Sage 100 ODBC queries. Run `npm run bridge -- --discover` on the Sage server to list the real table and column names, and adjust here if your Sage version names differ. Each query must return the aliased columns shown. {SINCE} becomes the date 60 days ago (yyyy-mm-dd).
invoices: SELECT InvoiceNo, InvoiceDate, CustomerNo, CustomerPONo AS PO, (TaxableSalesAmt + NonTaxableSalesAmt + SalesTaxAmt + FreightAmt) AS Total FROM AR_InvoiceHistoryHeader WHERE InvoiceDate >= '{SINCE}'
openOrders: SELECT SalesOrderNo, CustomerPONo AS PO, CurrentInvoiceNo, BillToName FROM SO_SalesOrderHeader
